facts.fact: Subscribers: 91,991 at 2025-Q4 (end December 2025), per NCC subscriber statistics, for Starlink Internet Services Nigeria Ltd.
Subscribers: 66,523 at 2025-Q2, per NCC subscriber statistics, for Starlink Internet Services Nigeria Ltd.
Subscribers: 59,509 at 2025-Q1, per NCC subscriber statistics, for Starlink; down from 65,564 at Q3 2024 after a price rise and capacity limits.
Starlink Internet Services Nigeria Ltd sells satellite internet in Nigeria and ended Q4 2025 with 91,991 subscribers, the second-largest ISP behind Spectranet.

systems.owner: SpaceX / Starlink Internet Services Nigeria Ltd
